# Blue Key Mortgage (bluekeymortgage.ca)

Blue Key Mortgage is the practice of Ragini Domenichini, a licensed Mortgage
Agent Level 2 with BRX Mortgage Inc. (FSRA #13549), specializing in reverse
mortgages for Ontario homeowners aged 55+. Plain English education, free
no obligation consultations, and comparisons across all three Canadian
reverse mortgage lenders: HomeEquity Bank (CHIP), Equitable Bank (Flex),
and Bloom Financial. Reverse mortgages in Canada differ from US HECM rules.

Contact: 647-231-3910 · ragini@bluekeymortgage.ca

- https://bluekeymortgage.ca/faq.html : 20 questions seniors and adult children ask, answered honestly
- https://bluekeymortgage.ca/right-for-you.html : Honest self-assessment (including when a reverse mortgage is wrong)

- https://bluekeymortgage.ca/guide.html : Free 20-page Ontario home equity guide
